rationale: The instrument exhibits conflicting signals between its fundamental/macro backdrop and its intraday price action. While it gapped down 26% on an earnings miss amid a 4% broad market selloff, it has rallied since the open to trade near session highs (94.3% of range) well above VWAP ($32.97) and the 5m 9-EMA ($33.59). Buying near the session high fights the severe macro and fundamental headwinds, while shorting at $34.00 fights established intraday upward momentum without a confirmed exhaustion signal.
